answer: What survives to the forge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The horizon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the zephyr. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, burned when the recruit misbehaves. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
